items.name: sfx_knock
items.text: Two sharp knuckle knocks on a wooden table top, knock knock.

items.name: sfx_clink
items.text: Two small ceramic wine cups clinking together in a toast, one bright clink.

items.name: sfx_cheer
items.text: A small rowdy tavern crowd of men cheering and laughing, hooray, clapping, cups banging on tables.

items.name: sfx_gate
items.text: A huge heavy wooden palace gate swinging shut with a deep booming slam and a creak.

items.name: sfx_boot
items.text: A tight leather boot being pulled off a foot with effort, a squeaky leather pop.

items.name: sfx_pour_gold
items.text: A heap of gold ingots and coins poured out of a wooden box onto a wooden table, clattering.
